docs.title: AI大禮包測試資料
docs.text:
Info

使用 Bidder 大禮包的測試 OID 做為 iTest AI 大禮包的測資 (only TDY)

參考：Bidder大禮包(Profile API)測試資料

docs.title: Steps, Links, and Commands
docs.text:
1. Announce the suspension of iTest monitoring in Slack channel #big-td-platform

    • iTest heartbeat interval is set to 30 mins (CAMD-25735). Remember to announce that Opsgenie alerts are expected and can be ignored during the maintenance.

  2. Suspend the Argo cron job

    • Bidder 大禮包
      • Staging: itest-regular-test-stg
      • Production: itest-regular-test-prd
    • AI 大禮包
      • Production: itest-regular-test-prd-ai-bidding

  3. Perform test data maintenance

    • For data addition, create new test data in production iDash then add new cid in iTest config:
      • Bidder 大禮包 — idash-api-server-prd-manual-test.yaml (save as testcases.yaml in local itest-cli folder)
      • AI 大禮包 — ai-bidding-idash-api-server-prd-manual-test.yaml (save as ai-bidding-testcases.yaml in local itest-cli folder)
    • For data modification, update existing test data in production iDash.

  4. Update iTest test data & upload to GCS

    Refer to the README of the itest-cli repo for tool installation, config file preparation, and data upload. Add new cid in local testcases.yaml if needed.

    Optional: install consul-template via Homebrew

    # Tap the HashiCorp repository
brew tap hashicorp/tap

# Install Consul Template
brew install hashicorp/tap/consul-template

# Verify the installation
consul-template -version

  5. Resume the Argo cron job.

  6. Monitor the successful execution of the Argo cron job.

  7. Announce the iTest monitoring is resumed in Slack channel #big-td-platform.

docs.title: Attachments to download manually
docs.text:
Confluence MCP can't download binary attachments, so you need to save these from Confluence by hand. Steps for each entry:

  1. Open the original Confluence page (link in Source column).
  2. Right-click the image → Save image as...
  3. Save with the filename listed in Target file below.
  4. Place it in docs/idash/iTest/assets/.

When done, delete this file.
